chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibrahim al-Karkhi, from Talha ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) used to drink from Syrian cups that were brought from Syria and gifted to him (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.الأَقْدَاح الشَّامِيَّة: Syrian cups — drinking vessels crafted in al-Sham (the Levant/Syria region), which was renowned in early Islamic times for its fine craftsmanship in glassware and pottery
key_terms.تُهْدَى: gifted/offered as gifts — indicating the cups were presented as formal gifts (hadiyya), making them permissible for the Prophet to accept and use
key_terms.يُجَاءُ بِهَا: were brought — passive voice indicating these cups were transported and delivered to the Prophet

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad use Syrian cups? What does this hadith from Al-Kafi say about the Prophet's drinking vessels?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) used to drink from Syrian cups (aqdāh shāmiyya) that were brought from Syria and presented to him as gifts. The hadith is narrated by Imam al-Sadiq (AS) through a chain including the companion Talha ibn Zayd. This narration serves as evidence that accepting gifts from non-Muslim regions and using imported vessels was practiced and approved by the Prophet, informing jurisprudential discussions about the permissibility of using foreign-made cups and utensils.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibrahim Al Karkhy, from Talha Bin Zayd, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to drink in the Syrian cup which they came with from Syria and was gifted unto him<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Ibrahim al-Karkhiy from Talhah ibn Zayd who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, would drink water in bowls from Syria that were brought from there and given as gifts to him (the Messenger of Allah). 5 ”
